els.name: card_copy.1.card_description
els.text: A local bakery with low online visibility implemented a comprehensive digital marketing strategy. The business created a professional website, optimized its Google Business Profile for local searches, launched targeted Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns, and consistently shared high-quality content, special offers, and customer testimonials. These efforts helped increase brand awareness, attract new customers, and strengthen customer engagement.

els.name: card_copy.1.card_description
els.text: Within just three months, the bakery achieved significant improvements in its business performance. Website traffic increased by 180%, online orders grew by 120%, social media followers increased by 250%, and overall revenue rose by 40%. This case study demonstrates how a well-planned digital marketing strategy can improve online visibility, increase customer engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.

els.name: headline_intro_text.1.introduction
